item.title: Hotfix 15.2
item.description:
HOTFIX 15.2

GAMEPLAY AND BALANCING TWEAKS

Melee in PvE

One-Handed Thunder Hammer

Gameplay

  • Accumulation stance can be entered even if the hammer already has charges. If the hammer has maximum charges the Charged Impact attack will be triggered.

  • Time for getting 1 charge is decreased to 1.25 seconds.

  • Energy Loop now can be performed after Charged Impact. Energy loop damage is increased by 100%.

  • Underhand Swing damage is increased by 30%.

  • Charged Impact damage is increased by 15%.

Weapon Perks

  • “Preparedness” and “Brutal Reforge” perks now trigger when an enemy was killed with a Finisher by a One Handed Hammer.

  • “Preparedness” perk ability restoration is increased to 5%.

  • “Perfect Reprisal” ability damage bonus is increased to 50%. Fixed an issue that applied the bonus damage to any melee attack instead of just Light Attacks.

Heroic One-Handed Thunder Hammer - Power Maul

  • Heroic perk no longer deals increased damage based on the number of charges.

  • Charged Impact now can be performed with 1-2 charges.

  • Ground Slam now can be performed with 3 charges.

  • Ground Slam now forces stagger enemies.

  • Ground Slam damage is increased by 30% and attack radius is increased by 100%.

Please note that the text descriptions for the Power Maul have not been updated to reflect these changes, they will be updated in a future patch.

CRUCIBLE

  • Fixed an issue where the Guardian Relic was disabled for the entire team when only one player activated the Curse of the Warp Penance.

  • Fixed an issue where Stratagems allowed players to select a mission and difficulty for Crucible through the Hub Terminal.

  • Fixed an issue where PvE Quick Match players could be matched into Crucible.

GENERAL FIXES

  • Tactical: Fixed a bug where the Bolt Rifle used in the secondary slot would deal less damage than in the primary slot when using the “Tactical Reserve” perk.

  • Tactical: Fixed a bug with the Plasma Pistol having the buff from "Versatility" even if no Primary Weapon was equipped.

  • Chaos Siege: Fixed a spawn issue where enemy Loyalist Marine could spawn behind the closed gates in some cases.

  • Siege: Fixed a bug with Techmarine’s Weighty Attack class challenge not progressing with One Handed Thunder Hammer charged kills.

  • Siege: Fixed a  softlock where Space Marines could get stuck in the transition zone after a wave sequence.

  • Crash fixes and general stability improvements.

  • Lots of minor UI and localisation fixes.

item.title: Hotfix 1.13.3 patch notes
item.description:
Warband!

Hotfix 1.13.3 is now being rolled out on all platforms, and while you wait for it to download you can read the notes below!

This hotfix contains tons of bug fixes, as well as some tweaks to the Spillway end event and Expeditions.

Patch 1.13.3 patch notes

Features & Tweaks

  • Spillway End Event:

    • Bots now prioritize helping incapacitated players over participating in the fight against the Prophet of Decay in the Spillway mission.

    • The Prophet of Decay now has a constant damage zone around him during the circle phase. The damage zone matches the VFX previously in place.

    • Updated the VFX displayed when hitting the shield of the Prophet of Decay.

    • (Havoc) Weakened Monstrosities can no longer spawn for the duration of the event.

    • Specialist Surge Strikes can no longer occur during the event.

  • Expeditions: Players who disconnect when there is a rescue reward for them will now be replaced by a pickup near the respawn beacon containing the reward.

  • The Relic Blade Sprint Heavy Stab buff from held charge while sprinting can now also be triggered while dashing through the ‘Chastise the Wicked’ / ‘Fury of the Faithful’ Abilities.

Fixes
General Fixes

  • Removed the Penance related to Heretical Idols in the ‘Depths’ zone.

    • Dev Note: We are planning to add back this Penance in a future update that will add Heretical Idols to the Spillway mission.

  • Fixed an issue where Veteran’s ‘Executioner’s Stance’ Ability could not be refreshed by kills performed through sticky attacks (e.g. Special activated attacks with the Assault Chainsword).

  • Pack Master: Fixed an issue where all of their strikes would apply the Stamina and Dodge Reset debuff to players.

    • Now only attacks performed with their electrical maul will apply the debuff.

  • Scab & Dreg Vanguards: Fixed an issue where certain attacks caused an incorrect stagger reaction.

  • Expeditions:

    • Fixed an issue where Medicae Stations would fail to display their usage cost.

    • Fixed an issue where the Scrap amount displayed after hot joining would be incorrect.

  • Fixed an issue where flickering could be experienced when transitioning into the Prophet of Decay intro cutscene.  

  • Fixed an issue where a red hitmarker would be displayed on every hit after already having killed the Prophet of Decay, before transitioning to the outro cutscene. 

  • Fixed Companion nameplates not updating the name after a Personality Scourge.

  • Fixed an issue where the Skitarii ‘Power Drive’ upgrade talent for the ‘Overload’ Keystone sometimes could fail to give the correct amount of stacks after using the ‘Advanced Combat Doctrines’ Ability, if it had consumed all the available Capacitance charges in one use.

  • Fixed a rare crash that could happen if a player started spectating a Psyker just as the operative gained an amount of Peril.

  • Fixed a crash that could happen if a player exited a mission or the Meat Grinder while a smoke cloud effect was active (e.g. Veteran’s ‘Smoke Grenade’).

  • Fixed an issue where Corruption damage would fail to kill players that had a fully corrupted Health bar.

  • Fixed an issue where Zealot’s ‘Until Death’ talent could be triggered when receiving Corruption damage while at 1 Health point, even if the Health bar was otherwise not fully corrupted.

  • Fixed an issue where Psyker’s ‘Empyric Recovery’ Penance could not be completed.

  • Fixed an issue where Skitarii’s ‘Sicarian Disciple’ Penance could not be completed.

  • Fixed an issue where Skitarii’s ‘Advanced Combat Doctrines’ Ability could lock-on friendly players instead of enemies after having tried to use the Artificer Servo-Skull Blitz at 0 charges.

  • Fixed an issue where Skitarii’s ‘Chordclaw Strike’ Ability would play an incorrect sound effect.

  • Fixed an issue where stacks from the ‘Blaze Away' and 'Inspiring Barrage' weapon Blessings could be reset when shooting in ADS stance with the Ogryn’s Thugshot weapon.

  • Fixed an issue where Ogryn’s ‘Lucky Bullet’ triggers from talents could reset the ‘Blaze Away’ weapon Blessing stacks for the Kickback and Thugshot weapon families.

  • Fixed an issue where Ogryn’s ‘No Stopping Me!’ talent would not be applied when charging the Heavy 2 attack on both Battle Maul & Slab Shield weapon marks.

  • Fixed an issue where an incorrect additional notification was displayed when reaching the max Mastery level for the Ogryn’s Battle Maul & Slab Shield weapon family.

  • Fixed an issue where the Mortis Trials Skitarii’s ‘Hard-Wired Reaction Boost’ buff would consume a larger than intended amount of Capacitance when triggered.

  • Fixed an issue where locked missions appeared as unlocked on the mission board.

  • Fixed an issue where players would be blocked from matchmaking if a Strike Team member changed operatives at a specific timing.

  • Fixed some potential frame drops when using the Emote Wheel or Communication Wheel if DLSS is enabled.

  • The Audio Devices list is now properly evaluated when changed and is updated in the audio settings.

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Fixed a minor issue where the Vostroyan Flak Coat with Psykana Collar had inconsistent shoulder pads.

  • Fixed an issue where the Athonian 98th Fatigues sleeves clipped with the vambraces.

  • Fixed an issue where the muzzle of Ursula's Hope would not heat up visually.

  • Fixed a material issue where metal parts was displayed incorrectly on Brute Model Cranial Implant (XXXXL), Commemorative head screws, and Cranial-Coolant Implant.

  • Fixed an issue where Tanker Commander's Battlegear Cadian 802nd unintentionally changed colour - we restored the item to use the original colour again.

  • Fixed an issue where Mordian Cleric Jacket intersected with many lower body cosmetics.

Known Issues

  • Scab and Dreg Vanguard enemies currently have slightly more health than intended.

That’s all for today!

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar. 

– The Darktide Team

item.title: Patch 9.0.4
item.description:
Hey folks,

We’ve just rolled out Patch 9.0.4 to Total War: WARHAMMER III, with a particular focus on optimising Nagash’s campaign experience, alongside various other fixes and adjustments across the board. You can read the full Patch Notes below, with Nagash-related items detailed in their own section, followed by all other changes.

As always, if you run into any new issues after updating the 9.0.4, please raise them over in our dedication bug reporting sub-forum. Please include as much information as you’re able to within your report, including screenshots and save files (mod-free if possible, or let us know in the report if you use mods), as this greatly helps us in our investigations.

Our intention is to have a 9.0.5 release within the next few weeks which, alongside various fixes and adjustments, should include some improvements to Victory Objectives with the goal of making them more relevant and impactful.

Until then, we’ll see you on the battlefield!

— The Total War Team

Nagash

Campaign
General/Gameplay

  • Expanded the search functionality in The Black Pyramid to now also match the names of specific units contained within unit sets and other hover-over text.

  • Fixed an issue when playing as Nagash where a fort settlement obtained via confederation or diplomacy had the wrong settlement type and main building.

  • Fixed an issue where the ‘Sun-Scorched, Sand-Blistered’ node on the Black Pyramid was not applying flaming attacks to Ushabti (Great Bows), Horse Archers & Horse Chariots.

  • Fixed a Grave Call unlocking node in the Black Pyramid which was incorrectly giving access to the wrong units.

  • Fixed an issue where the Lahmian Halls and Halls of Glories Past would lock again for Nagash after loading a save, even if Neferata and Walach had previously been subjugated.

  • When playing as Nagash, fighting battles in a region that is not part of Land of the Dead now shows a warning icon that no Necromantic Energy is granted from battles in that region.

  • Fixed an issue where Necromantic Energy from battles was not being awarded if the battle was fought in a region with an abandoned settlement.

  • Nagash's building effects that are enabled by devastation now take effect immediately instead of in the next turn.

  • Fixed an issue where Nagash's gold resource buildings weren't granting their Lord recruit rank bonus when replacing an existing Lord.

  • Fixed an issue where Nagash's landmark in the Black Pyramid of Nagash was granting 1 additional Lord recruit rank than it should when replacing Lords rather than recruiting new Lords.

  • Fixed an issue where the Nameless would remain on the Campaign map after their death during Crisis Mode events.

  • Fixed an issue where Nagash was able to recruit Regiments of Renown outside of his owned territories.

  • Fixed an issue where some of Luthor Harkon's ship buildings were not working after being confederated by Nagash.

  • Fixed an issue where Nagash’s Necropolis tutorial could function incorrectly when Hotkeys are pressed.

  • Fixed an issue where transferring a Book of Nagash could not work correctly in some sea regions and open seas.

Skills, Abilities & Traits

  • Adjusted Pinnacle of Servitude skill for Nagash, reducing its Recruit Rank bonus to 1, but allowing it to also apply to units recruited via Grave Call.

  • Fixed an issue where the Black Pyramid Sigil "Named to Protect" could cause Heroes to gain multiple stacks of the Guardian ability.

Items & Ancillaries

  • Fixed an issue where Isabella was unable to reequip the Blood Chalice of Bathori if unequipped after confederating Sylvania as Nagash.

UI

  • Fixed an issue where The Great Blades Unsheathed node in the Black Pyramid was displaying the wrong effect icon.

  • Fixed an issue where the available sigils UI in the Black Pyramid was not returning to the correct position after spending or refunding a sigil, resulting in it being positioned slightly off-screen.

  • Nagash’s Grave Call Recruitment button is now greyed-out when unavailable. Additionally, we have added a tooltip explaining that it is only available in Land of the Dead.

  • Fixed an issue when playing as Nagash where some buildings could show as Ruined in landmark building chains.

  • Fixed an issue where Subjugating the Nameless or some of the other Legendary Hero Mortarchs could show the wrong text.

  • Fixed an issue when playing as Nagash where the Encamp army stance incorrectly mentioned Global recruitment.

  • Fixed an issue where some tooltips that grant extra ability uses in the Black Pyramid panel were missing details of that ability.

  • Attempting to Occupy, Colonise or Resettle a region as a Necropolis now indicates if the Necropolis limit will be exceeded as a result.

  • Fixed an issue where some mission objectives in the Mortarchs panel were lacking a button to zoom to the relevant location for that objective.

  • Fixed an issue where Dieter Helsnicht's "The Silent Legion" requirement text exceeded the dimensions of the text box.

  • Fixed an issue where the Sigil Browser in The Black Pyramid would overlap the Shambling Hordes cluster of nodes when fully zoomed out at some resolutions and UI scaling options.

  • Fixed an issue where an empty tooltip would show for some factions when hovering over a Book of Nagash that another army was carrying.

  • Clicking on the Land of the Dead panel name now opens a help page about the Land of the Dead within the Province panel, as with other settlements.

  • The settlement requirements text for the Ritual of Undeath no longer appears after the Ritual of Undeath has been enacted.

  • Fixed an issue where the "Disempower Sigils" button in The Black Pyramid would be active even when no Sigils are currently Empowered.

  • Fixed an issue where spells granted to Nagash by Awakening the power of a Book of Nagash showed a different number of uses in his character details panel than in the Books of Nagash panel.

  • Removed progress bars from the Mortarch mission objectives to make the panel UI more consistent.

VFX

  • Fixed an issue where Nagash’s persistent VFX would linger in another character’s ‘Character Detail’ view when clicking between two characters.

  • Fixed an issue where the VFX could flicker in some character details portholes, including Nagash.

Battle
Maps

  • The Khemri siege battle map now features the Black Pyramid of Nagash looming over the city.

Spells & Abilities

  • Fixed an issue where the Book of Nagash spell ‘Incantation of the Skullstorm’ would incorrectly target the area behind the unit that needs to be targeted.

  • Reduced the trigger time for Screaming Skull Catapults' homing ability, granted by the Black Pyramid ‘Seeker of Kindred Skulls’ node, from 3s to 2s.

VFX

  • Fixed an issue where moving Nagash to a new position during the deployment phase would leave lingering VFX in his previous location.

Multiplayer

  • Nagash buildings locked behind subjugations will now be unlocked if Neferata or Walach start or become owned by a co-op partner in multiplayer campaigns.

  • Fixed an issue where Nagash's buildings locked behind subjugation remained locked if Neferata or Walach start or become owned by a co-op partner.

Additional Release Notes

Performance & Stability

  • Fixed a crash that could occur after ending the turn during the Nagash End Times crisis.

  • Fixed an issue where the game could freeze for a long period of time during very late game turn ends.

Campaign
General/Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where, after the Chaos Invasion Endgame had concluded, a razed region colonised by a faction would become unoccupiable by any factions subsequently conquering that region.

  • Fixed an issue where the player was unable to construct the port building in the Altar of the Horned Rat after capturing it from the Vermintide faction. (Please note that this will only affect new campaigns.)

  • Fixed an issue where The Liche High Priest (Nehekhara) was unable to correctly unlock Arcane Conduit.

  • Storm attrition generated by a player-spawned storm no longer affects the player’s armies or those of allied factions.

  • Fixed an issue where Short Victory rewards that decrease the cost of Bloodlines rituals were not being applied correctly.

  • Fixed an issue where the Altdorf College of Forbidden Magic landmark was incorrectly providing double the amount of Winds Of Magic power reserve per turn.

  • Fixed an issue where some characters no longer had a background Trait after their faction is confederated.

  • In the Great-Smart plans, when attempting a Verminlord summon, you can now see for each selection the base Verminlord's unit card from the Verminlord that will be summoned if successful.

  • When attempting a Verminlord summon in the Great-Smart plans panel, each option now displays the base Verminlord’s unit card that will be summoned if successful.

  • Fixed an issue where the Enforce Confederation option for Warriors of Chaos was incorrectly vassalising instead of properly confederating.

  • Fixed an issue where Styrkaar’s mission was triggering for all factions instead of only Slaanesh, Warriors of Chaos and Norsca.

  • Fixed an issue where some Lords could lose access to some of their mounts after being confederated. (Please note that this will only affect new campaigns.)

Skills, Abilities & Traits

  • Fixed an issue where Arkhan's skill ‘Legions of Death’ was not affecting Chillgheists.

UI

  • Fixed an issue where the Vampire Counts confederation requirement for the target faction to have no more than 5 regions was not displayed.

  • Fixed some inconsistencies with scrolling behaviour within the unit recruitment panel.

  • Added missing localisations for text strings introduced in 9.0.3.

VFX

  • Fixed an issue where a character that has lost The Nemesis Crown could still have the VFX as if they were still carrying it.

Battle
Spells & Abilities

  • Reduced the duration of the ‘Soul Slaying Hunger’ ability to more accurately match the Visual Effect duration.

  • Reduced the radius of ‘Mist Form’ ability to more accurately match the Visual Effect and targeting area.

  • Fixed an issue where Invocation of Nehek could be cast on units that have reached their healing cap in battle.

Multiplayer

  • Added the ability for the host of a Multiplayer lobby to see and adjust the AI Anti-Player Bias slider.

⚠ IMPORTANT

If you experience any issues after downloading the update, please take a moment to Verify the integrity of the game files first to ensure there were no issues when downloading. A step-by-step guide can be found in this article. If the issues persist, please visit our support site for additional troubleshooting steps and assistance.

🧱 MOD WARNING

Please note that user-generated mods may have compatibility issues with new game updates. If you are encountering performance or stability issues following a release, is recommended that you disable any mods you're running. If you continue to experience issues, please visit our support site for additional troubleshooting steps and assistance.

  • Fixed an issue where the available sigils UI in the Black Pyramid was not returning to the correct position after spending or refunding a sigil, resulting in it being positioned slightly off-screen.

  • Nagash’s Grave Call Recruitment button is now greyed-out when unavailable. Additionally, we have added a tooltip explaining that it is only available in Land of the Dead.

  • Fixed an issue when playing as Nagash where some buildings could show as Ruined in landmark building chains.

  • Fixed an issue where Subjugating the Nameless or some of the other Legendary Hero Mortarchs could show the wrong text.

  • Fixed an issue when playing as Nagash where the Encamp army stance incorrectly mentioned Global recruitment.

  • Fixed an issue where some tooltips that grant extra ability uses in the Black Pyramid panel were missing details of that ability.

  • Attempting to Occupy, Colonise or Resettle a region as a Necropolis now indicates if the Necropolis limit will be exceeded as a result.

  • Fixed an issue where some mission objectives in the Mortarchs panel were lacking a button to zoom to the relevant location for that objective.

  • Fixed an issue where Dieter Helsnicht's "The Silent Legion" requirement text exceeded the dimensions of the text box.

  • Fixed an issue where the Sigil Browser in The Black Pyramid would overlap the Shambling Hordes cluster of nodes when fully zoomed out at some resolutions and UI scaling options.

  • Fixed an issue where an empty tooltip would show for some factions when hovering over a Book of Nagash that another army was carrying.

  • Clicking on the Land of the Dead panel name now opens a help page about the Land of the Dead within the Province panel, as with other settlements.

  • The settlement requirements text for the Ritual of Undeath no longer appears after the Ritual of Undeath has been enacted.

  • Fixed an issue where the "Disempower Sigils" button in The Black Pyramid would be active even when no Sigils are currently Empowered.

  • Fixed an issue where spells granted to Nagash by Awakening the power of a Book of Nagash showed a different number of uses in his character details panel than in the Books of Nagash panel.

  • Removed progress bars from the Mortarch mission objectives to make the panel UI more consistent.

VFX

  • Fixed an issue where Nagash’s persistent VFX would linger in another character’s ‘Character Detail’ view when clicking between two characters.

  • Fixed an issue where the VFX could flicker in some character details portholes, including Nagash.

Battle
Maps

  • The Khemri siege battle map now features the Black Pyramid of Nagash looming over the city.

Spells & Abilities

  • Fixed an issue where the Book of Nagash spell ‘Incantation of the Skullstorm’ would incorrectly target the area behind the unit that needs to be targeted.

  • Reduced the trigger time for Screaming Skull Catapults' homing ability, granted by the Black Pyramid ‘Seeker of Kindred Skulls’ node, from 3s to 2s.

VFX

  • Fixed an issue where moving Nagash to a new position during the deployment phase would leave lingering VFX in his previous location.

Multiplayer

  • Nagash buildings locked behind subjugations will now be unlocked if Neferata or Walach start or become owned by a co-op partner in multiplayer campaigns.

  • Fixed an issue where Nagash's buildings locked behind subjugation remained locked if Neferata or Walach start or become owned by a co-op partner.

Additional Release Notes

Performance & Stability

  • Fixed a crash that could occur after ending the turn during the Nagash End Times crisis.

  • Fixed an issue where the game could freeze for a long period of time during very late game turn ends.

Campaign
General/Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where, after the Chaos Invasion Endgame had concluded, a razed region colonised by a faction would become unoccupiable by any factions subsequently conquering that region.

  • Fixed an issue where the player was unable to construct the port building in the Altar of the Horned Rat after capturing it from the Vermintide faction. (Please note that this will only affect new campaigns.)

  • Fixed an issue where The Liche High Priest (Nehekhara) was unable to correctly unlock Arcane Conduit.

  • Storm attrition generated by a player-spawned storm no longer affects the player’s armies or those of allied factions.

  • Fixed an issue where Short Victory rewards that decrease the cost of Bloodlines rituals were not being applied correctly.

  • Fixed an issue where the Altdorf College of Forbidden Magic landmark was incorrectly providing double the amount of Winds Of Magic power reserve per turn.

  • Fixed an issue where some characters no longer had a background Trait after their faction is confederated.

  • In the Great-Smart plans, when attempting a Verminlord summon, you can now see for each selection the base Verminlord's unit card from the Verminlord that will be summoned if successful.

  • When attempting a Verminlord summon in the Great-Smart plans panel, each option now displays the base Verminlord’s unit card that will be summoned if successful.

  • Fixed an issue where the Enforce Confederation option for Warriors of Chaos was incorrectly vassalising instead of properly confederating.

  • Fixed an issue where Styrkaar’s mission was triggering for all factions instead of only Slaanesh, Warriors of Chaos and Norsca.

  • Fixed an issue where some Lords could lose access to some of their mounts after being confederated. (Please note that this will only affect new campaigns.)

Skills, Abilities & Traits

  • Fixed an issue where Arkhan's skill ‘Legions of Death’ was not affecting Chillgheists.

UI

  • Fixed an issue where the Vampire Counts confederation requirement for the target faction to have no more than 5 regions was not displayed.

  • Fixed some inconsistencies with scrolling behaviour within the unit recruitment panel.

  • Added missing localisations for text strings introduced in 9.0.3.

VFX

  • Fixed an issue where a character that has lost The Nemesis Crown could still have the VFX as if they were still carrying it.

Battle
Spells & Abilities

  • Reduced the duration of the ‘Soul Slaying Hunger’ ability to more accurately match the Visual Effect duration.

  • Reduced the radius of ‘Mist Form’ ability to more accurately match the Visual Effect and targeting area.

  • Fixed an issue where Invocation of Nehek could be cast on units that have reached their healing cap in battle.

Multiplayer

  • Added the ability for the host of a Multiplayer lobby to see and adjust the AI Anti-Player Bias slider.

⚠ IMPORTANT

If you experience any issues after downloading the update, please take a moment to Verify the integrity of the game files first to ensure there were no issues when downloading. A step-by-step guide can be found in this article. If the issues persist, please visit our support site for additional troubleshooting steps and assistance.

🧱 MOD WARNING

Please note that user-generated mods may have compatibility issues with new game updates. If you are encountering performance or stability issues following a release, is recommended that you disable any mods you're running. If you continue to experience issues, please visit our support site for additional troubleshooting steps and assistance.

item.title: Zealot Archetype: In the Name of the God-Emperor
item.description:
Service to the God-Emperor takes many forms. Among the denizens of the Imperium, there are those who devote their lives not only to spreading His word, but to personally delivering His wrath as well.

Meet the Zealot — a new melee-focused first-tier archetype that makes their debut in the Processional of the Damned DLC. A powerful short-range combatant, the Zealot combines an arsenal of area-of-effect attacks with great effectiveness in drawing the attention of the enemy.

The new companion, Stella, belongs to this archetype, but the Zealot is not exclusive to her — this option will also be available to the Lord Captain at character creation.

After all, a Rogue Trader is one of the most powerful conduits of His will!



Up Close and Personal

The Zealot’s niche on the battlefield is that of a splash-damage fighter/off-tank who prefers operating close to enemy lines, drawing attention with a reliable taunt mechanic.

This archetype utilises maces, hammers and other brutal bludgeoning weapons. Yet the Zealot is not limited exclusively to melee combat — their arsenal also includes more exotic options, such as swinging weapons bound to chains or even hurling them at the enemy.

The Zealot’s primary stats are Weapon Skill, Strength, Toughness and Willpower, and their abilities scale with Athletics, Carouse, Lore (Imperium), Lore (Warp) and Lore (Xenos). In fact, Lore skills will directly affect how much damage is inflicted on the appropriate enemy category — talk about knowing your enemy!

On the second tier, Zealot may advance into Vanguard, Archmilitant, Master Tactician, or Executioner, further amplifying their defensive and offensive capabilities.


Wrath of the God-Emperor

The first keystone ability of the Zealot, Thunderous Echo, is a special passive effect applied to any attacks made with bludgeoning weapons, adding an area-of-effect modifier to them.

With this effect, all enemies and allies within one additional tile of the weapon’s normal attack pattern take additional damage, with the amount of damage scaling differently for one-handed and two-handed weapons. The damage is also doubled on prone targets.

The image below showcases the pattern:


This ability provides the Zealot with an excellent tool for dealing with hordes of weaker enemies or applying negative effects to multiple targets at once. Talents may further increase the affected area or modify its shape and damage.

But be wary of friendly fire — your allies will also suffer damage if they end up in the afflicted area!

Judgement From Afar

The Zealot’s second, and arguably even more exciting, keystone ability is called the Zealous Throw:

The Zealot throws their weapon into the target cell, dealing weapon damage to the first creature in its path. All creatures around the target receive additional damage from Thunderous Echo. The weapon then returns to the Zealot’s hand. Works only with bludgeoning weapons.

This ability does not count towards the attack limit per turn and can be further enhanced by a number of talents, including the option to throw two one-handed weapons at once.

Who said hammers and maces were not ranged weapons, anyway?



Let Them Come

Unlike Blade Dancer from the Void Shadows DLC, the Zealot does not boast exceptional mobility. Instead, they prefer to let the enemy get up close, with two distinct tools for making them do so:

1) The third keystone ability called Ardour, which costs 1 AP to activate:

For 1 round, all enemies that were dealt damage by the Zealot consider them a priority target. All incoming damage dealt to the Zealot is decreased by (Carouse / 10)% per affected target.

2) An archetype ability called Sacrifice Thyself:

The Zealot makes a religious cry in a radius equal to (WIL Bonus) cells around them. Enemies in the radius must pass a WIL Test (-Zealot's level) or move as close as possible to the Zealot.
Daemons fail this Test automatically.

This gives the Zealot a significant degree of control over the distribution of incoming damage, making them a reliable tank indeed. They may not be as sturdy as Abelard at first, but combined with late-game abilities from their second-tier archetypes, they can become a force to be reckoned with.

Break the Chains

What about Heroic Acts and Desperate measures? Let’s have a look at them as well:

The Zealot’s Heroic Act is called the Unchained Punishment:

Until the end of the turn, the Zealot starts spinning their chained bludgeoning weapon and gains (WIL Bonus) stacks of Unchained Punishment. After moving into an adjacent cell, they consume 1 stack and deal 50% weapon damage to all enemies within 1 cell. These strikes trigger Thunderous Echo. Upon activation, the Zealot automatically deals damage to all enemies within 1 cell, while not consuming any stacks. Once all stacks are consumed, the Zealot continues moving as usual.

With a two-handed weapon, strikes deal (WS Bonus) additional damage. With a weapon in each hand, the Zealot strikes twice per cell traversed.

Removes Immobilized. Until all stacks of Unchained Punishment are consumed, the Zealot cannot change their weapon set. While moving, the Zealot does not trigger attacks of opportunity.

The Desperate Measure version of this ability adds the following downsides:

The Zealot receives Direct damage equal to 5% of their maximum Wounds per cell traversed.
After the turn ends and until the end of the combat, the Zealot's max MP are decreased to (WIL Bonus).

Upgrades to these abilities include additional damage, a pushback effect, and increased block chance and protection from the damage done to allies.

Time to dust off your thunder hammer, Lord Captain!





More Details

The archetype has several other area-of-effect abilities and is supplemented by a plethora of talents and new items designed for it. These include modifications and boosts to damage, mobility, tanking options, attack range, attack pattern size, pushback, additional negative effects on inflicting damage, and much more.

While we won’t go into each and every one of them for now, the Zealot archetype will offer a rich variety of build options.

And of course, let’s not forget the synergy this archetype is designed to have with Stella’s origin — the Miraculist. The combination of their abilities opens up a wide range of different playstyles.



That is all for today, but stay tuned for more exciting details about the Processional of the Damned.

The God-Emperor protects!

--
Disclaimer: Some of the numbers and ability names are still work in progress and may change in the final version.
